description: Write a literal string/bytes value to an S3 object as a Dagster asset -- mirrors Airflow's S3CreateObjectOperator.

outputs.description: Writes the given data to the destination S3 object.

data.label: Data
data.description: Literal string data to write. Set this or data_asset_key (not both). Encoded as UTF-8 bytes before upload.

data_asset_key.label: Data Asset Key
data_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key whose materialized value (str or bytes) is written as the object body. Set this or data (not both).

dest_s3_url.label: Dest S3 Url
dest_s3_url.description: Destination object as 's3://bucket/key'. Set this or bucket+key.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.description: Destination bucket name. Set with key, or use dest_s3_url instead.

key.label: Key
key.description: Destination object key. Set with bucket, or use dest_s3_url instead.

replace.label: Replace
replace.description: False (default, matches S3CreateObjectOperator): fail clearly if the destination key already exists, checked via head_object before writing. True: always write, overwriting any existing object.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered aws_s3_resource. When set, credentials/session come from that resource instead of a bare boto3.client('s3', region_name=...).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Kill the wait and fail the run if the write hasn't finished after this many seconds. Enforced via a background-thread wrapper -- the underlying boto3 call may continue running past the deadline (Python threads can't be forcibly killed); this bounds the step's wait, not the call itself.
